title: An Android multipart request fixture (C224.4)
description: Workflow 10B Stage 1a (contracts-10b): a .multipart.json request fixture is this whole JSON value, written by its client owner's MockEngine test against the real FlowApiClient under UPDATE_CONTRACT_FIXTURES=1. fields are the form fields as sent, in order, each a string, parsed by the index entry's schema (flowFileUploadFieldsSchema); file is the file part's name, its filename (<kind>.<extension>, never a person's own file name), its content type and its size in bytes, never its bytes. apps/api/src/routes/flow/flow-requests.android.test.ts parses it so.
